data.name: Rushdi
data.gender_notes: Rushdi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rushdi is an Arabic name that means 'rightly guided' or 'on the right path'. It is a name that symbolizes guidance and wisdom. The name Rushdi carries the meaning “Rightly Guided” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rushdi usually hope their child will grow to embody rightly guided and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rushdi is associated with the concept of hidayah, or divine guidance.
data.etymology: Rushdi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rightly Guided.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rushdi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رشدي
in_arabic.meaning: منسوب إلى الإمام رشدي في الفقه الإسلامي
in_arabic.long_meaning: رشدي هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'رشاد' التي تعني الهداية والاستقامة على الطريق الصحيح. يرتبط هذا الاسم بالإمام رشدي، وهو شخصية فقهية إسلامية معروفة. يتميز حامل هذا الاسم بالحكمة والفهم العميق للدين الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: رشدی
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی فقہ میں امام رشدی سے منسوب
in_urdu.long_meaning: رشدی ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے ہدایت یافتہ یا راستے پر چلنے والا۔ یہ نام امام رشدی کے ساتھ منسلک ہے، جو اسلامی فقہ کے ایک معروف امام ہیں۔ اس نام کے حاملین کو حکمت اور اسلامی تعلیمات کی گہری سمجھ کے ساتھ منسوب کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रश्दी
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी न्यायशास्त्र में इमाम रश्दी से संबंधित
in_hindi.long_meaning: रश्दी एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा में हुई है। इसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन प्राप्त या सही रास्ते पर चलने वाला। यह नाम इमाम रश्दी से जुड़ा है, जो इस्लामी न्यायशास्त्र के एक प्रमुख व्यक्ति थे। इस नाम के धारकों को ज्ञान और इस्लामी शिक्षाओं की गहरी समझ के साथ जोड़ा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: رشدي
in_pashto.meaning: په اسلامي فقه کې د امام رشدي منسوب
in_pashto.long_meaning: رشدي د مذکر نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. د دې مطلب دى هدايت شوی يا د سړي د لارې چلونکى. دا نوم د امام رشدي سره تړلی دی، چا چې د اسلامي فقه يو مشهور امام و. د دې نوم خاوندان د حکمت او د اسلامي زده کړو ژور پوهه سره منسوب دي.

in_english.name: Rushdi
in_english.meaning: Related to Imam Rushdi in Islamic jurisprudence
in_english.long_meaning: Rushdi is a masculine name derived from Arabic, meaning 'guided' or 'one who walks on the right path.' It is associated with Imam Rushdi, a notable figure in Islamic jurisprudence. The name signifies wisdom, deep understanding of Islamic teachings, and spiritual guidance. It reflects a strong connection to Islamic tradition and heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rushdi holds significant cultural influence in the Islamic world as it is often associated with the righteous caliphs and prophets in Islamic history, who are seen as providing guidance and leading their communities towards the path of righteousness. It is also a popular choice for children in the Muslim world, reflecting the values of guidance, wisdom, and beliefs in the righteous path.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Rushdi lies in its meaning, which is deeply rooted in Islamic teachings of following the right path, striving for knowledge, and seeking wisdom and guidance from Allah. It embodies the principles of seeking truth and righteousness in all aspects of life, aligning oneself with the will of Allah and living a purposeful and virtuous life. It serves as a reminder to stay focused on the spiritual journey and keep moving towards the path of righteousness and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rushdi was a vizier under the Ayyubid Sultan Salah ad-Din Al-Afdal (1137-1171). The name Rushdi carried significant weight in that era.
